implied_$_is_a_CEILING: list & cache-OFF: $435M/mo vs OR actual ~$76M/mo (2026-06) = 5.7x. OR spend was ~FLAT Mar~$83M->Jun$76M, so the gap is list-vs-realized (caching-off + provider discounting), NOT growth.

input_heaviness: platform prompt:completion = 40.1:1 (98% input tokens) => $ is an INPUT-price construct
free_token_share: 6.9% of text tokens are $0 free-variant (padding the token base; use paid-token share to compare $)
